conditions.displayName: Gmail API 4xx responses above 1 per second over 5 minutes

documentation.content: Sustained Gmail API 4xx responses in maru-mail-prod. Covers Gmail 403 and 429 spikes. A project-wide 403 spike can signal client suspension or a consent-screen problem. Check the OAuth client state and the consent screen first. Runbook: ops/google-oauth/INCIDENT.md.
